name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool result is still needed verbatim; below it the result is truncated. A Noul of 0.5 means Jev is unsure, so keep this low.

keepCallThreshold.title: Keep call threshold
keepCallThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that the tool call itself is still needed; below it the call is removed along with its result. Keep this low: a call costs a fraction of its result, and removing it erases the record that the work happened.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

archiveResults.title: Archive dropped tool output
archiveResults.description: Write the full text of dropped tool calls and results to .claude/fast-jev-compaction/ and cite the file in the marker left in their place, so it can be read back.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request. Jev allows 64k.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

resultPreviewChars.title: Tool result preview for Jev
resultPreviewChars.description: Characters from each end of a tool result quoted in its keep question, so Jev can judge the content and not only its length; 0 disables.

salvageChars.title: Salvaged identifiers and errors
salvageChars.description: Characters of identifiers and error lines recovered from the dropped part of a tool result and kept alongside its truncation note; 0 disables.

proseTrim.title: Trim assistant prose
proseTrim.description: off (default), trim or tidy: also drop filler clauses from old assistant text and prose tool inputs, and cut old code bodies in tool inputs.

jevPruneBashOutput.title: Trim Bash output with Jev
jevPruneBashOutput.description: Opt-in: before a Bash tool result reaches the transcript, ask Jev to trim its stdout when it is long. A second Jev call site of its own, separate from compaction; off by default.

jevPruneMinChars.title: Minimum Bash output length to trim
jevPruneMinChars.description: Stdout shorter than this is left alone even when jevPruneBashOutput is on.
